integrity: Standalone exact rational sign certificates for seven boundary pairs and an independent finite convex-hull diagnostic; the infinite classification follows analytic inequalities in the proof.
scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean embedding, a single missing bipartite edge, integer part sizes at least two; the claim does not cover multiple edge deletions or arbitrary affine changes. Elementary face-volume formulas are background; priority concerns the sharp quotient classification. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: A sharp isoperimetric sign transition after deleting one edge of a complete bipartite root polytope
